div.p: A service-disabled veteran-owned distributor with a 1946 military precision legacy — now El Paso's mission-critical partner for industrial MRO and power transmission.

div.h1: From Military Precision to Mission-Critical Industry.
div.p: RBC Industrial LLC, 3950 Doniphan Dr. Ste P, El Paso, Texas 79922 · Phone 915-845-8188 · Sales@rbc-industrial.com

RBC Industrial traces its roots to 1946, when a U.S. Navy Naval Engineering Officer founded the original firm on a simple but demanding standard: military precision. What began as the Roger Brown Co. legacy of exacting quality and disciplined delivery has evolved into today's RBC Industrial — a modern, service-disabled veteran-owned distributor serving heavy industry across the border region.

We carry that founding discipline into every bearing, gear reducer, seal, and motor we source. Our team of trained engineers applies the same rigor a naval engineer would to a ship's drivetrain — because an idled production line has the same cost as an idled mission.

Based in El Paso at 3950 Doniphan Dr. Ste P, we operate as a brand-agnostic sourcing partner: no captive brand quotas, no sales scripts — just the right part, cross-referenced and delivered at the right time. Our five-minute proximity to the Juárez border makes us the natural supply link for the maquiladora corridor, and our same-day emergency response keeps lines running on both sides of the bridge.
Delivering the right product at the right time, every time.

li.div: Founded by a U.S. Navy Naval Engineering Officer on a standard of military precision.
The founding firm's exacting quality and delivery discipline carries forward.
SDVOSB distributor in El Paso serving industrial plants and Juárez maquiladoras.
Engineer-led sales, brand-agnostic sourcing, same-day line-down response.

div.blockquote: "Delivering the right product at the right time, every time!"

div.p: When you call RBC, you reach someone who can read your spec sheet back to you — and challenge it if it's wrong for the application.
Our sales team is made of trained engineers. Torque curves, bearing preload, seal chemistry — they speak your language.
We identify equivalent parts across manufacturers so you are never locked into a single brand or forced to wait on a sole-source lead time.
Every recommendation is measured against one metric: keeping your production line running. If it won't run, we won't sell it.
RBC Industrial's certifications remove barriers for buyers in the public and private sector alike.
Federally recognized SDVOSB certification supporting set-aside opportunities for government and prime contractors.
State of Texas HUB certification enabling participation in state procurement and cooperative contracts.
Founded on the exacting standards of a U.S. Navy Naval Engineering Officer in 1946 — quality, not just compliance.
